record.field: Privilege: an employee records their own attendance from Telegram

Held by the attendance commands of a Telegram chat: find the sender's employee, and read, start and close that employee's attendances at the time they type, lunch break included. A linked user reaches only the employee they are; a contact with no user only an employee without one whose contact a Telegram account was ever bound to. Odoo's own check-in takes the current time only, so the typed time is this privilege's.
